p: Plaxis is the Discord bot for server levels (chat XP, up to level 500 in xp.json), coins, slots, idle RPG, and more. This guide matches the current bot build; numeric defaults come from JSON config files and may change when staff reload config.
Some features are still being tuned during open testing. If something looks wrong, use /bug or open a /ticket — we read every report.
Chat with other players and get updates: discord.gg/WU4X3zTwJq
Read General commands for a full command cheat sheet.
Follow Getting started for your first coins and games.
Browse the sidebar — topics are in A–Z order, with Help & support at the bottom.
First steps in a few minutes
Quick reference for the most common Plaxis slash commands. For full details, open the topic pages in the sidebar (A–Z), or start with Getting started.
Send coins to someone in your server
What others see on your card
Help for chests, wheels, turbo, etc.
In any channel where Plaxis is allowed, type /.
Pick a command or group (eco, game, rpg, etc.) or a top-level command (profile, profile-edit, xp, leaderboard, …).
Fill in required options and press Enter.
Grouped commands use a prefix — for example /eco balance and /rpg hunt. Profile customization uses /profile-edit, /profile-privacy, and similar (not a /profile subcommand group).
Shows your Plaxis ID — a permanent support number tied to your Discord account.
Quote it in /ticket or when staff deliver items by ID
Run /id once and save the number somewhere private. You do not need to share it publicly unless you want staff to look up your account.
Staff owner tools during soft launch often use Plaxis ID, not @mention.
Your profile can optionally show Plaxis ID to others if you enable it in /profile-privacy.
Your profile card (level, balance, RPG summary)
Show or hide Plaxis ID on your public card
Support — mention your Plaxis ID in the description if asked
Shows how much currency you have.
Amount: Receive a set amount once a day, with bonuses for starting streaks on daily claims
Send currency to another member in the same server.
Must be positive; you need enough balance
/rpg boss-attack — defeating blow while ranked top 10 on damage
/rpg raid-attack — defeating blow on the raid boss (dragon default: 400 coins, 120 XP)
(Future economy features may use the same wallet)
Balances show as two decimal places (e.g. 1250.00).

l: 1. Make sure Plaxis is in your server
p: Your server admin needs to invite the bot and grant it permissions to read messages (for chat XP) and use slash commands. If / does not show Plaxis commands, ask staff to re-invite or check channel permissions.
Only you see the reply. Save this number for support tickets or when staff grant items during soft launch.
You can claim once every 24 hours. s
/profile shows your public card. Use /profile-edit to add a tagline, bio, and pronouns.
Start on the free Common Floor machine, or unlock more themes with coins.
Pick warrior, mage, or rogue, then hunt for XP and coins.
Default scope is the server you are using the command in. Use Global for all-server rankings.
Slots and RPG usually say coins.
It is the same wallet — one balance for everything.
Chat XP — Messages of at least 8 characters earn server level XP about every 55 seconds. Check /xp for your bar and title.
Privacy — /profile-privacy controls what others see when they view your card.
Full RPG sheet — /rpg profile has HP, gear, and stats; /profile is your social card.
Shows top players ranked by category.
level or xp; coins, balance, or eco; rpg
server, guild, or local (this guild only); global, world, worldwide, or all
scope:server — Only members in this Discord server who have used Plaxis. Must be run in a guild channel (not DMs).
scope:global — Top players across all servers the bot is in.
If the server board is empty, play a few games or run /eco daily so your stats exist — then try again.
Idle RPG commands are under /rpg. Progress is saved to your account across servers.
Full RPG sheet: class, level, XP, HP, attack, defense, equipped weapon and armor. Use /profile for your social card with a short RPG line.
Lists equippable weapons and armor in your inventory.
Example item IDs: rusty_sword, iron_blade, shadow_dagger, leather_vest, chainmail, mystic_robe
During soft launch, staff may grant test gear with owner tools.
Fight a random enemy for XP and coins. Uses your class and equipped gear.
Collect passive coins and XP based on time since your last claim.
The bot tells you how long to wait if you claim too early
One boss HP pool shared by every server Plaxis is in.
Deal damage (server channel only, not DMs)
You can only attack when a boss is active. If none is spawned, the bot will tell you to wait for an announcement.
Attack cooldown: attackCooldownSeconds in config (default 30 seconds)
Rewards: If you land the defeating blow and your rank is in the top 10, you get bonus coins and XP (default template: 2000 coins, 500 XP)
Sets where this server receives spawn/defeat announcements. Requires Manage Server.
Start a raid (raid_id optional, default dragon)
Damage the raid boss (defeating blow pays rewards to that player)
All raid commands require a server channel (not DMs). You must /rpg raid-join before /rpg raid-attack. Default dragon raid lasts 30 minutes (durationMinutes in config).
Spin the machine and bet coins.
Coin wager. Use 0 only if you have free spins saved
Pick from your unlocked machines; otherwise uses your active machine

Each spin shows 5 reels with a short spin animation, then your result. Rare events can add free spins, multipliers, pick-a-chest, or bonus / jackpot wheels. Buttons appear on the spin message — use them before they expire.
Line wins (best match on the row): 5× jackpot symbol · 5× any symbol · 4× · 3× · 2× — multipliers are set per theme in game/slot_themes.json.
Lists all machines: theme, unlock cost, RTP, and which you own.
Spend coins to permanently unlock a machine.
Set your default machine when you omit machine on /game slots.
Help text for add-ons: chests, wheels, double-or-nothing, turbo, and other rare events. Reply is only visible to you (ephemeral).
Unlock costs and RTP come from the live game config. Use /game slots-machines in Discord for your current unlock status.
~45% chance to double your win or lose it
After some spins, buttons appear on the same message:
Chests and wheels last about 3 minutes. Double-or-nothing lasts about 2 minutes. Run a fresh /game slots if buttons stop working.
Re-spin instantly at your last bet
Reveal bonus coins (one chest may be empty)
Tap buttons on the result message when they appear
Your Plaxis profile is the card other players see when they look you up — plus the stats you choose to show.
Tagline and bio (if you set them)
Server level, title, and XP bar
RPG summary — class, level, HP, ATK, DEF (if visible)
Optional — view someone else’s card (their privacy rules apply)
Your own /profile reply is only visible to you. Viewing another member posts the card in the channel.
Quick text view of level, title, and XP progress (no full card).
Leave a field blank to keep your current text.
Type CLEAR in a field to remove it.
Control what other players see on your /profile:
Run with no options to see your current settings (e.g. /profile-privacy show_balance:false).
You always see your full card on your own /profile. Privacy only affects other viewers.
Profile frames and badges are planned after open testing. This command explains what is coming later.
Social card — level, coins, short RPG line, bio
Full RPG sheet — gear, HP, attack, defense, XP to next level
Open a private support conversation with the Plaxis team.
Run /ticket in any server or DM.
Staff reply via bot DM. Keep chatting in DMs until the issue is resolved.
Use Close ticket in your DM when you are done.
Add your /id number in the ticket description if staff need to find your account.
Report a bug for the development team.
You get a private confirmation with a bug number (e.g. Bug #42).
Use this for broken commands, wrong payouts, or UI issues — not for general questions (use /ticket instead).
Account help, rewards, ban appeals to Plaxis
Something is broken or wrong in the bot
Plaxis also has moderation and security tools for server staff. Those commands are not in this player guide — they are documented internally for moderators and bot owners.
